<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe " <!ENTITY ent 'expanded_entity'> ">
  %pe;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "external.png" NDATA png>
  <?target-pi data="processing-instruction-content"?>
  <!-- A detailed comment inside the DOCTYPE subset -->
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.com/ns2">
  <!-- Top level comment -->
  <?custom-pi test="value"?>
  <child ns2:attr="test">&ent;</child>
  <ns2:child>
    <![CDATA[
      Some CDATA content with markup-like characters: <tag> & "quotes"
    ]]>
  </ns2:child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA | sub)*>
  <!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY ref "&base;Extended">
  <!ENTITY % param '
    <!ELEMENT nested (#PCDATA)>
    <!ENTITY internal "NestedEntity">
  '>
  %param;
  <?pi-target data="value"?>
  <!-- Comment in DTD -->
]>
<doc xmlns="http://w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:xml="http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace">
  <!-- Another comment -->
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
  <section xml:id="sec1">
    &ref; &internal;
    <![CDATA[
      <![CDATA[ Nested CDATA attempt ]]>
    ]]>
  </section>
</doc>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (description)>
  <!ELEMENT description (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "Data1">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "Data2 &ent1;">
  <!ENTITY % ext-subset SYSTEM "http://localhost/nonexistent.dtd">
  %ext-subset;
  <?xml-app process="start"?>
  <!-- Comprehensive comment block -->
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <?app-pi target="run"?>
  <!-- Comment before item -->
  <item xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.com">
    <description>
      <![CDATA[ CDATA block with unescaped <, >, and & characters. ]]>
      &ent2;
    </description>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (node)*>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Value1">
  <!ENTITY e2 "Value2">
  <!ENTITY e3 "&e1;&e2;">
  <!ENTITY % dtd-decl "<!ENTITY dynamic 'DynamicallyDefined'>">
  %dtd-decl;
  <?xml-pi-doc type="test"?>
  <!-- Initial DTD comment -->
]>
<document xmlns="urn:document:ns" xmlns:meta="urn:document:meta" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <!-- Document level comment -->
  <?meta:instruction status="active"?>
  <node xsi:nil="true"/>
  <meta:node>
    <![CDATA[
      Some complex CDATA containing XML tags: <node>&e3;</node>
    ]]>
  </meta:node>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE testsuite [
  <!ELEMENT testsuite (testcase+)>
  <!ELEMENT testcase (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent-a "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY ent-b "Beta &ent-a;">
  <!ENTITY % entity-set '
    <!ENTITY ent-c "Gamma">
    <!ENTITY ent-d "&ent-c; &ent-b;">
  '>
  %entity-set;
  <?log-target level="debug"?>
  <!-- DTD tracking comment -->
]>
<testsuite xmlns="http://test.org/schema" xmlns:tr="http://test.org/track">
  <!-- Main body comment -->
  <?tr:action type="initialize"?>
  <testcase tr:id="tc001">
    &ent-d;
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section verifying entity references like &ent-a; are literal inside CDATA.
    ]]>
  </testcase>
</testsuite>
```
